title: Dark Mode & Custom Theme Support
description: Add support for an automated dark theme based on system preferences, with an explicit toggle in the navigation bar and customizable accent colors.
author: Priya Sharma

comments.author: Alex Chen
comments.content: This was the most requested feature! Looks incredible in dark mode.

title: OAuth Social Login (GitHub & Google)
description: Allow users to log in seamlessly with GitHub or Google accounts instead of creating manual passwords, enabling automatic avatar and profile sync.
author: Liam Vance

comments.author: Sarah Miller
comments.content: GitHub OAuth is essential for developer workflows. Please support both GitHub and Google.

title: Export Analytics & Feedback to CSV and JSON
description: Provide a 1-click export button for project admins to download all submitted feedback, vote counts, and user remarks in CSV and JSON formats.
author: Marcus Brody

title: Discord & Slack Webhook Notifications
description: Trigger an automated message to a designated Discord channel or Slack incoming webhook whenever a new feedback item is posted or status is updated.
author: Elena Rostova

comments.author: Jordan Patel
comments.content: Would love Slack notifications whenever a status changes to 'planned'.

title: Fix Horizontal Overflow on Mobile Screens
description: On viewport widths under 420px, the filter tabs causes slight horizontal scroll. Need to convert tab row to a scrollable pill container or dropdown.
author: Rohan Das

title: Markdown Preview Support in Feature Descriptions
description: Enable basic markdown rendering (bold, code blocks, bullet points) in feature descriptions and comments for cleaner technical proposals.
author: Dev Team
